reasons: The cited original text (11.1: immediate discontinuation of assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support) sits at the playbook walk-away position, so a deviation finding with an insert/replace redline is directionally correct.

The redline reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, express export/migration support, and deletion permitted only per Sections 11.2/11.3 (which per the rationale already supply machine-readable return within 30 days and certified deletion), avoiding duplication of those mechanics.

The failed 'minimal edit' check (0.850 changed-character ratio) is expected and acceptable here: the original clause is an outright cut-off and deletion provision that cannot be salvaged by a narrow tweak, and the replacement is a single compact paragraph.
Comment is accurate, in the required tone and prefix, explains the change, ties it to Sections 10.1/11.2/11.3, and offers the 90-day fallback.
